scripts.dev: env CI=1 WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler d1 migrations apply edgechat-db --local && exec env WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler dev --port 8787 --var REGISTRATION_MODE:open
scripts.build: exec env WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.preview: env CI=1 WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler d1 migrations apply edgechat-db --local && test -f .wrangler/preview-assets/index.html && exec env WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler dev --assets .wrangler/preview-assets --port 8787 --var REGISTRATION_MODE:open
scripts.preview:tunnel: env CI=1 WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler d1 migrations apply edgechat-db --local && test -f .wrangler/preview-assets/index.html && exec env WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler dev --assets .wrangler/preview-assets --port 8787 --tunnel --var REGISTRATION_MODE:open
scripts.cf-typegen: exec env WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.db:migrate:local: exec env WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler d1 migrations apply edgechat-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: exec env WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler d1 migrations apply edgechat-db --remote
scripts.db:bookmark:remote: exec env WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler d1 time-travel info edgechat-db --json
